product_risk_or_requirement: Risk chain CASE-03 privacy moment: applicant data and protected audit attributes require purpose limitation, separation, security, retention, deletion, re-identification, vendor, and transfer controls
current_state: A high-level data inventory exists, but the lawful-basis and role analysis, de-identification provenance and linkage test, impact assessment, retention schedule, access test, deletion test, transfer map, and vendor terms are not approved.
product_requirement: Process only approved job-relevant fields for recommendations; admit no live or identifiable applicant data to shadow evaluation; admit real-person-derived de-identified historical data only after approved provenance, transformation, re-identification, retention, and access evidence; keep fairness-audit attributes in a separately controlled environment unavailable to model and hiring users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a real-person-derived historical record When the documented de-identification and linkage test runs before shadow ingestion Then direct identifiers are absent, zero records are re-identified in the pre-registered attack test, provenance and transformation are reproducible, and the Data Protection Officer accepts residual linkage risk. Given an applicant record and separately supplied audit attribute When the approved flow runs Then only allowlisted fields reach the model, hiring users cannot access audit attributes, and every access and transfer is logged. Given an access or deletion request When the rights workflow runs Then its due date follows the counsel-approved jurisdiction matrix, including one month for GDPR unless a lawful extension applies, and the response or exception is logged. Given retention expiry When deletion executes Then active copies are removed and vendor deletion is confirmed.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any real-person-derived historical record enters shadow evaluation and before any real applicant enters live use
evidence_needed: Signed data inventory and flow; purpose and lawful-basis memo; source provenance and reproducible de-identification record; pre-registered re-identification and linkage attack report; data protection impact assessment; jurisdiction rights-and-deadline matrix; role and transfer map; retention schedule; access-control and deletion tests; incident procedure; vendor data-processing and subprocessor terms

product_risk_or_requirement: Risk chain CASE-03 vendor integration and all harm rows: the product must detect disparity, prohibited status writes, hidden applications, vendor changes, complaints, and incidents and support a controlled manual fallback and rollback
current_state: Metric, queue, and integrity triggers are specified, but production-grade lineage, alerts, on-call ownership, impacted-application identification, rollback, notification, and restart drills are incomplete.
product_requirement: Maintain versioned input, configuration, output, human-decision, override, notice, appeal, and incident records; alert on approved thresholds; let the accountable owner pause recommendations and restore the full manual queue; require reassessment and independent restart approval after incidents or material changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a seeded automatic-write attempt, hidden application, and unregistered vendor version change When the online incident drill runs Then each event is detected within 15 minutes, recommendations are paused, the chronological manual queue remains available, affected applications and versions are identified, evidence is preserved, and the on-call owner is alerted immediately. Given a completed cohort batch meeting pre-registered sample rules When the scheduled KRI job runs Then disparity is evaluated within one business day, the Talent Product Owner and review panel receive the result, and any breach keeps restart blocked until corrective evidence and independent approval exist.
deadline_or_trigger: Before live pilot promotion and at least quarterly thereafter
evidence_needed: End-to-end lineage sample; online-integrity and batch-KRI alert tests; named on-call and escalation matrix; pause and manual-fallback rehearsal; affected-record query; incident timeline; rollback record; corrective-action and signed restart template

product_risk_or_requirement: Legal classification, actor roles, applicable dates, and evidence obligations must be approved separately for each target market
current_state: The pack records a preliminary Vietnam uncertainty and EU high-risk classification, but no counsel-signed workflow mapping, provider and deployer allocation, Article 6(3) exception analysis, applicability memo, or jurisdiction readiness inventory exists.
product_requirement: Block live use until counsel maps the frozen intended purpose, recommendation influence, human authority, data flow, vendors, and market to Vietnam's AI instruments and the consolidated EU AI Act, documents Article 6(3), assigns provider and deployer duties, records applicable dates, and identifies each required control and evidence owner.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen product scope, system boundary, automation level, vendor contracts, and target market When qualified Vietnam and EU counsel perform independent reviews Then separate signed memoranda state the classification and reasoning, EU Article 6(3) analysis, actor roles, applicable and transition dates, unresolved assumptions, required evidence and owners, and a reclassification trigger; any unresolved release-critical legal question keeps that market disabled.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any live Vietnam use and before offering or deploying the product in the European Union; re-check on 2026-10-15
evidence_needed: Signed Vietnam classification memo; signed EU Annex III 4(a), Article 6(3), and role memo; system inventory; obligations-to-evidence matrix; market enablement approval; reclassification and regulatory-change watch procedure

product_risk_or_requirement: Risk chain CASE-01 and CASE-02: a review-order recommendation must never hide or time out an application or become an adverse employment action without informed and reversible human judgment
current_state: Shadow mode is separated from live status writes and retains the complete queue, but queue-SLA enforcement, reviewer permissions, evidence display, adverse-status taxonomy, reason capture, appeal SLA, and negative-path tests are not independently signed off.
product_requirement: Before live use, every complete application must remain visible and receive human review within the requisition SLA; each human status change requires review of original evidence and uncertainty plus a review record; rejection, non-advance, or hold beyond the SLA additionally requires a job-related reason and appeal notice, while a separate reviewer can reinstate the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete application at any model-assigned queue position When a recruiter creates a shortlist or attempts to close the requisition Then original evidence and uncertainty remain visible, the action is blocked until every complete application has a human review record within no more than five business days, and every model-written status attempt is blocked and logged. Given a recruiter records rejection, non-advance, or a hold beyond the SLA When the adverse status is saved Then a job-related reason and appeal notice are mandatory. Given a timely candidate appeal When an independent reviewer examines the original application, model evidence, and human reason Then that reviewer can reinstate or correct the application within two business days without hiring-manager approval.
target_milestone: Meaningful human oversight, queue exposure, and appeal gate
deadline_or_trigger: Before any recommendation is visible in a live hiring workflow
evidence_needed: Role-and-permission matrix; adverse-status taxonomy; queue-visibility and SLA report; end-to-end demo recording; blocked-close and blocked-write test logs; sampled human review records; reason-code report; candidate notice and appeal-SLA rehearsal

product_risk_or_requirement: Risk chain CASE-02 and CASE-03: job-related ranking validity and subgroup exposure must be demonstrated without treating one fairness ratio as proof of non-discrimination
current_state: The deterministic queue-band and cohort rules are defined, but no representative local evaluation set, independently adjudicated labels, precision-derived sample floor, two-run result, less-disparate alternative decision, or independent validation report exists.
product_requirement: A frozen release candidate must pass pre-registered job-related validity, first-review-band exposure, intersectional subgroup, qualified-applicant recall, proxy-feature, and less-disparate alternative evaluations on representative data before promotion; historical hiring outcomes cannot be the sole qualification label, and an underpowered cohort cannot count as passing evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen model, deterministic daily snapshot, ceiling, tie, and late-arrival rules, a pre-registered cohort list and two-sided 95 percent interval method, precision-derived sample floors fixed before outcome access, and qualified labels assigned independently by two trained assessors with a third resolving disagreement When two evaluation runs separately use non-overlapping representative samples of at least 400 applications each Then overall qualified-applicant first-review-band recall is at least 95 percent in each run; every cohort in each run has a confidence-interval lower bound of at least 0.80 for its assignment-rate ratio and an upper bound of at most 5 percentage points for its absolute recall gap; an underpowered, missing-attribute, or inconclusive cohort keeps the gate open; and proxy findings are resolved. Given a candidate alternative that also meets the 95 percent recall and 30 percent time targets When its worst-cohort upper-bound recall gap improves by at least 2 percentage points without worsening another cohort or guardrail Then that alternative is selected, or the independent panel and risk owner document and sign a job-related operational reason for rejection.
deadline_or_trigger: Before live pilot promotion and after any model, label, feature, threshold, job-family, population, snapshot, tie-break, or first-review-band change
evidence_needed: Pre-registered construct, cohort, deterministic queue, precision, confidence-interval, and alternative-selection plan; dataset provenance and representativeness report; blinded label and adjudication log; counterbalanced time-study log; two non-overlapping reproducible evaluation reports with point estimates, confidence bounds, sample sizes, missingness, and inconclusive cohorts; feature/proxy and alternative decision record; independent approval

product_risk_or_requirement: Risk chain CASE-03 accessibility moment: FairScreen adopts effective notice, accessible participation, accommodation, reason information, and a no-penalty manual path as product safeguards across both target markets
current_state: Notice and accommodation journeys and internal one-business-day response target are designed but have not been independently tested against WCAG 2.2 AA or mapped by counsel to market-specific legal duties.
product_requirement: Before assessment, each candidate must receive accessible plain-language notice of the AI role and data use, an accommodation channel and equivalent manual alternative; after any human non-advance decision, the candidate must receive a job-related reason category and appeal route. These are product release safeguards; counsel must map each element to applicable Vietnam and EU law before it is represented as a statutory duty.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pre-registered browser and assistive-technology matrix When an independent evaluator tests the complete candidate journey Then every applicable WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA success criterion passes and no severity-1 critical or severity-2 serious defect remains under the approved defect taxonomy. Given a candidate accommodation request When the workflow receives it Then automated scoring freezes, the internal acknowledgement target of one business day is met, and an equivalent no-penalty alternative plus deadline extension is provided. Given a human non-advance decision When notice is issued Then it contains a job-related reason category and an independent appeal route that can correct the record.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any live applicant enters the assisted workflow
evidence_needed: Plain-language notice; market-specific counsel mapping; lawful-basis review where applicable; WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report; browser and assistive-technology matrix; defect taxonomy and closure log; accommodation rehearsal timestamps; manual-alternative evidence; reason and appeal templates
